name: metagenomic-assembly-binning
description: Assemble metagenomic reads into contigs and bin contigs into metagenome-assembled genomes (MAGs). MEGAHIT uses a succinct de Bruijn graph with multiple k-mer sizes for memory-efficient assembly. MetaBAT2 bins contigs by tetranucleotide frequency and differential coverage across samples. CheckM evaluates MAG quality using single-copy marker genes.
